::: {#exr-two-small-filters}

#### Two small filters or one large one

Two stacked $3 \times 3$ [convolutional layers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-convolutional-layer) and one $5 \times 5$ layer have the same [receptive field](#def-receptive-field).
Suppose every layer has $C$ input [channels](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-channel) and $C$ output channels.
Which of the two designs has fewer weights,
not counting biases?

:::
